item.title: Exact Brand Name on Label

turns.text: Make a product photo of an amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label. The brand on the label must read VELORA, spelled exactly like that.

item.tests: Produces a finished product image with exact, legible brand lettering integrated into the bottle label.

answer_sheet.Product and materials: An amber glass hand soap bottle with a cream label.

must_haves: An amber glass hand soap bottle is the main subject.
A cream-colored label is visibly attached to the bottle.
The label reads exactly 'VELORA' in clear uppercase letters.
The brand lettering sits within the label and looks integrated, not like a floating caption.
The brand name is unobscured and readable at the delivered image size.

style.prompt: Premium photorealistic studio product photograph of a single amber glass hand soap bottle with a refined black pump dispenser and a matte cream paper label. The label must display the brand name exactly "VELORA" in large, crisp, clearly legible elegant uppercase typography: V E L O R A. No other brand names, no misspellings, no extra letters. Small understated text below may read "HAND SOAP". Bottle centered on a warm ivory stone surface with a seamless warm cream background, soft diffused side lighting, delicate realistic shadow, rich translucent amber glass, subtle highlights, minimalist luxury skincare editorial styling. Straight-on camera, entire bottle and pump visible, sharp label in focus, realistic materials, clean uncluttered composition.
